title: Focused runs through scripts/test-temp-root.mjs record their test threads as unknown even when --test-threads is given
outcome: Focused runs through scripts/test-temp-root.mjs record their test threads as unknown even when --test-threads is given
acceptance: A focused run of `node scripts/test-temp-root.mjs cargo test ... -- --test-threads=4` records testThreads {source: "--test-threads", threads: 4}, covered by a launcher test.

Without a thread option, the wrapped form records RUST_TEST_THREADS or libtest-default exactly as the direct cargo form does, unless the wrapper changes that variable, in which case it records unknown.
Commands other than the repository's own wrapper keep recording unknown, as today.
